title: HSK 3.15 · 发明, 成果, 区别, 概念, 文学
focus: 尽量 · 及时 · 专门 · 决赛 · 背后 · 显得 · 明确 · 胖 · 土 · 念 · 村 · 缺 · 甜 · 成立 · 苹果 · 区别 · 声明 · 分别 · 数量 · 成就 · 果然 · 后果 · 文明 · 成果 · 概念 · 得分 · 落后 · 沙发 · 分配 · 发明 · 决心 · 文字 · 文学 · 缺少 · 发送 · 发言 · 观念 · 告别 · 光明 · 坚决
body:
Lots of overlapping pairs: 明 *bright, clear*, 发 *send out*, 果 *fruit, result*, 别 *separate*, 成 *become*, 文 *writing* and 念 *thought* each appear in three or more words. 果 starts as "fruit" (苹果) and becomes "result" (后果, 成果, 果然).

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 明 | míng | bright, clear (日 sun + 月 moon) | 明确, 声明, 文明, 发明, 光明 |
| 发 | fā | send out, issue | 沙发, 发明, 发送, 发言 |
| 果 | guǒ | fruit; result | 苹果, 果然, 后果, 成果 |
| 别 | bié | separate; other | 区别, 分别, 告别 |
| 成 | chéng | become, complete | 成立, 成就, 成果 |
| 文 | wén | writing, culture | 文明, 文字, 文学 |
| 念 | niàn | think of, read aloud (今 + 心) | 念, 概念, 观念 |
| 分 | fēn | divide; point | 分别, 得分, 分配 |

## Watch out

- 尽量 is usually **jǐnliàng** (do one's best); you'll also hear jìnliàng.
- 决 (冫 ice) vs 快 (忄 heart): both have 夬 on the right.
- 胖 is **pàng** (fat); pán is a rare literary reading.
- 沙发 is a sound loan of "sofa".

cards.Example: 我尽量早点来。 wǒ jǐnliàng zǎo diǎn lái: I'll try to come early
cards.Notes: 尽 to the limit + 量 amount = to the full amount, do one's best

cards.Example: 你来得很及时。 nǐ lái de hěn jíshí: You came just in time
cards.Notes: 及 reach (a hand catching a person) + 时 time = reach in time

cards.Example: 我专门来看你。 wǒ zhuānmén lái kàn nǐ: I came specially to see you
cards.Notes: 专 focused, special + 门 door, field = one specialized field

cards.Example: 我们进决赛了！ wǒmen jìn juésài le: We made the final!
cards.Notes: 决 decide (冫 + 夬 jué sound) + 赛 contest = deciding contest, the final

cards.Example: 别在背后说人。 bié zài bèihòu shuō rén: Don't talk behind people's backs
cards.Notes: 背 back (月 body + 北 běi sound) + 后 behind = behind the back

cards.Example: 他显得很累。 tā xiǎnde hěn lèi: He looks tired
cards.Notes: 显 show (日 sun + 业) + 得 get = shows as, appears

cards.Example: 他的目标很明确。 tā de mùbiāo hěn míngquè: His goal is clear
cards.Notes: 明 clear + 确 certain (石 stone) = clear and certain

cards.Example: 我最近胖了。 wǒ zuìjìn pàng le: I've put on weight
cards.Notes: 月 (flesh) + 半 bàn for the sound. 月 on the left of body words means flesh

cards.Example: 这件衣服有点土。 zhè jiàn yīfu yǒudiǎn tǔ: This outfit is a bit tacky
cards.Notes: Picture of a lump of earth on the ground. Lookalike: 士 shì has a longer top line

cards.Example: 我念给你听。 wǒ niàn gěi nǐ tīng: I'll read it to you
cards.Notes: 今 now + 心 heart = what's in your heart now, think of

cards.Example: 他住在村里。 tā zhù zài cūn li: He lives in the village
cards.Notes: 木 tree + 寸 cùn for the sound = village

cards.Example: 我们缺一个人。 wǒmen quē yí ge rén: We're one person short
cards.Notes: 缶 pot + 夬 jué (phonetic) = a chipped pot, lacking

cards.Example: 这个西瓜很甜。 zhège xīguā hěn tián: This watermelon is sweet
cards.Notes: 舌 tongue + 甘 sweet = sweet on the tongue

cards.Example: 公司去年成立。 gōngsī qùnián chénglì: The company was founded last year
cards.Notes: 成 complete + 立 stand = make it stand, establish

cards.Example: 我每天吃一个苹果。 wǒ měitiān chī yí ge píngguǒ: I eat an apple a day
cards.Notes: 苹 (艹 plant + 平 píng sound) + 果 fruit = apple

cards.Example: 有什么区别？ yǒu shénme qūbié: What's the difference?
cards.Notes: 区 area, distinguish + 别 separate = sort apart, difference

cards.Example: 公司发了一个声明。 gōngsī fā le yí ge shēngmíng: The company issued a statement
cards.Notes: 声 voice + 明 clear = say clearly, declare

cards.Example: 我们分别去吧。 wǒmen fēnbié qù ba: Let's go separately
cards.Notes: 分 divide + 别 separate = apart from each other

cards.Example: 数量不够。 shùliàng bú gòu: There aren't enough
cards.Notes: 数 number + 量 amount = quantity

cards.Example: 他的成就很大。 tā de chéngjiù hěn dà: His achievements are great
cards.Notes: 成 complete + 就 accomplish = what's been accomplished

cards.Example: 他果然来了。 tā guǒrán lái le: Sure enough, he came
cards.Notes: 果 result + 然 so = the result was so, as expected

cards.Example: 后果很严重。 hòuguǒ hěn yánzhòng: The consequences are serious
cards.Notes: 后 after + 果 result = result that comes after

cards.Example: 中国文明很古老。 Zhōngguó wénmíng hěn gǔlǎo: Chinese civilization is ancient
cards.Notes: 文 culture, writing + 明 bright = enlightened culture

cards.Example: 这是我们的成果。 zhè shì wǒmen de chéngguǒ: This is our result
cards.Notes: 成 achieve + 果 fruit = fruit of achievement

cards.Example: 我没有这个概念。 wǒ méiyǒu zhège gàiniàn: I have no notion of this
cards.Notes: 概 general + 念 idea = a general idea, concept

cards.Example: 他得分最多。 tā défēn zuì duō: He scored the most
cards.Notes: 得 get + 分 point = get points

cards.Example: 我不想落后。 wǒ bù xiǎng luòhòu: I don't want to fall behind
cards.Notes: 落 fall (艹 + 洛 luò sound) + 后 behind = fall behind

cards.Example: 他在沙发上睡着了。 tā zài shāfā shang shuìzháo le: He fell asleep on the sofa
cards.Notes: Sound loan of "sofa": 沙 sand (氵 + 少) + 发

cards.Example: 工作分配好了。 gōngzuò fēnpèi hǎo le: The work is assigned
cards.Notes: 分 divide + 配 allot, match = divide and allot

cards.Example: 谁发明了电话？ shéi fāmíng le diànhuà: Who invented the phone?
cards.Notes: 发 bring out + 明 bright, clear = bring to light, invent

cards.Example: 我下决心学中文。 wǒ xià juéxīn xué Zhōngwén: I've resolved to learn Chinese
cards.Notes: 决 decide + 心 heart = heart that has decided

cards.Example: 汉字是一种文字。 Hànzì shì yì zhǒng wénzì: Chinese characters are a script
cards.Notes: 文 pattern, writing + 字 character (宀 roof + 子 child) = written script

cards.Example: 我喜欢中国文学。 wǒ xǐhuan Zhōngguó wénxué: I like Chinese literature
cards.Notes: 文 writing + 学 study = the study of writing, literature

cards.Example: 我们缺少时间。 wǒmen quēshǎo shíjiān: We're short of time
cards.Notes: 缺 lack + 少 few = lacking

cards.Example: 我发送了邮件。 wǒ fāsòng le yóujiàn: I sent the email
cards.Notes: 发 send out + 送 deliver (辶 walk) = send

cards.Example: 下面请你发言。 xiàmiàn qǐng nǐ fāyán: Now please say a few words
cards.Notes: 发 put forth + 言 speech = put forth speech

cards.Example: 他的观念很老。 tā de guānniàn hěn lǎo: His views are old-fashioned
cards.Notes: 观 view + 念 thought = way of viewing and thinking

cards.Example: 我来跟你告别。 wǒ lái gēn nǐ gàobié: I've come to say goodbye
cards.Notes: 告 tell + 别 part = tell someone you're parting

cards.Example: 前途很光明。 qiántú hěn guāngmíng: The future is bright
cards.Notes: 光 light + 明 bright = bright light

cards.Example: 我坚决不同意。 wǒ jiānjué bù tóngyì: I firmly disagree
cards.Notes: 坚 firm + 决 decide = firmly decided
